# Utah 360 Events

> Utah 360 Events rents 360 slow-motion video booths and digital photo booths for weddings, corporate events, holiday parties, and birthdays in Utah County, Salt Lake County, and Park City, Utah. Every 360 rental is fully attended.

- Business name: Utah 360 Events
- Phone: (385) 404-9829
- Email: utah360events@gmail.com
- Website: https://utah360events.com
- Service area: Utah County (Provo, Orem, Lehi, American Fork), Salt Lake County (Salt Lake City), and Park City
- Booths: 360 slow-motion video booth (up to 5 guests per spin, onsite operator, custom overlay, videos shared directly to guests by AirDrop or text); digital photo booth (self-serve, unlimited digital photos, guests download by AirDrop or text; add-ons are a backdrop, a prop table, custom branding or overlay, and a red carpet experience with a red carpet and stanchions)
- Reviews: 5.0 on Google
- Booking: inquire with your date and venue at https://utah360events.com/contact.html
